rows.source_ko: 기후에너지환경부 (환경정책기술담당관), 044-201-6663
rows.text_en: Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment ( Environmental Policy and Technology Division ), 044-201-6663

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「환경정책기본법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Framework Act on Environmental Policy and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(환경기준 등의 공표) 기후에너지환경부장관은 「환경정책기본법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제12조에 따른 환경기준이 설정되거나 변경된 경우에는 법 제12조의2제1항에 따라 해당 환경기준 및 그 설정 근거(변경된 경우에는 변경 근거를 말한다)를 기후에너지환경부 인터넷 홈페이지에 게시하는 방법 등으로 공표해야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Publication of Environmental Standards, etc.) In the event that environmental standards are established or amended pursuant to Article 12 of the Framework Act on Environmental Policy (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall publish the relevant environmental standards and the grounds for their establishment (or the grounds for amendment in the case of amendment) in accordance with Article 12-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act, by means such as posting them on the internet homepage of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(시ㆍ도 환경계획의 수립 기준 및 작성 방법) ① 법 제18조제1항에 따른 시ㆍ도의 환경계획(이하 “시ㆍ도 환경계획”이라 한다)은 법 제14조에 따른 국가환경종합계획(이하 “국가환경종합계획”이라 한다)에 부합해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Standards for Establishment and Method of Preparation of City/Province Environmental Plans) ① City/Province environmental plans pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “City/Province Environmental Plans”) shall conform to the National Comprehensive Environmental Plan pursuant to Article 14 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “National Comprehensive Environmental Plan”).

rows.source_ko: ② 시ㆍ도지사는 다음 각 호의 사항을 포함하여 시ㆍ도 환경계획을 작성해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The mayor or provincial governor shall prepare a city or provincial environmental plan including the following matters:

rows.source_ko: 1. 다음 각 목의 환경에 관한 현황 분석 및 관리ㆍ보전 계획
rows.text_en: 1. Analysis of the current status and management and conservation plans regarding the environment in each of the following items

rows.source_ko: 가. 생태계 및 생물다양성 등 자연ㆍ생태환경
rows.text_en: a. Natural and ecological environment, including ecosystems and biodiversity

rows.source_ko: 나. 대기ㆍ수질ㆍ토양 및 기후 등 생활ㆍ기후환경
rows.text_en: B. Living and climatic environment, including air, water quality, soil, and climate

rows.source_ko: 2. 시ㆍ도 환경계획의 추진을 위한 조직 및 예산
rows.text_en: 2. Organization and budget for the implementation of city/province environmental plans

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항에서 규정한 사항 외에 시ㆍ도 환경계획의 수립 기준 및 작성 방법에 필요한 사항은 기후에너지환경부장관이 정한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 and 2, matters necessary for the standards for establishing and methods for drafting municipal and provincial environmental plans shall be determined by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment . <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

[This Article was newly added on July 6, 2021.]
[Formerly Article 3 was moved to Article 7 <July 6, 2021>]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(시ㆍ도 공간환경정보의 관리) ① 법 제18조제5항 및 영 제8조의2제2항에 따른 공간환경정보(이하 “시ㆍ도 공간환경정보”라 한다)에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Management of City/Province Spatial Environment Information) ① Spatial environment information pursuant to Article 18 , Paragraph 5 of the Act and Article 8-2, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as “City/Province Spatial Environment Information”) shall include the matters of each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 특별시장ㆍ광역시장ㆍ특별자치시장ㆍ도지사ㆍ특별자치도지사(이하 “시ㆍ도지사”라 한다)가 자체적으로 수집ㆍ생산하는 물, 대기, 자연생태 등 분야별 환경 현황에 관한 정보
rows.text_en: 1. Information on environmental status by sector, such as water, air, and natural ecosystems, independently collected and produced by the Mayor of a Special City, Metropolitan City, Special Self-Governing City, Governor of a Province, or Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province (hereinafter referred to as “City/Provincial Governor”)

rows.source_ko: 2. 그 밖에 기후에너지환경부장관이 정하여 고시하는 환경 현황에 관한 정보
rows.text_en: 2. Other information regarding the current environmental status determined and notified by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에서 규정한 사항 외에 시ㆍ도 공간환경정보의 관리에 필요한 사항은 기후에너지환경부장관이 정한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraph 1, matters necessary for the management of spatial environmental information of cities and provinces shall be determined by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment . <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>
[This Article Newly Inserted July 6, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(시ㆍ군ㆍ구 환경계획의 수립 기준 및 작성 방법) ① 법 제19조제1항에 따른 시ㆍ군ㆍ구(자치구의 구를 말한다. 이하 같다)의 환경계획(이하 이 조에서 “시ㆍ군ㆍ구 환경계획”이라 한다)은 국가환경종합계획과 시ㆍ도 환경계획에 부합해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Standards for Establishment and Method of Preparation of City, County, and District Environmental Plans) ① Environmental plans of cities, counties, and districts (referring to the districts of autonomous districts; hereinafter the same applies) pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “city, county, and district environmental plans” in this Article) must conform to the National Comprehensive Environmental Plan and the City/Province Environmental Plans.

rows.source_ko: ② 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장(자치구의 구청장을 말한다)은 다음 각 호의 사항을 포함하여 시ㆍ군ㆍ구 환경계획을 작성해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Mayor, County Governor, or District Head (referring to the District Head of an autonomous district) shall prepare a city, county, or district environmental plan including the following matters:

rows.source_ko: 1. 다음 각 목의 환경에 관한 현황 분석 및 관리ㆍ보전 계획
rows.text_en: 1. Analysis of the current status and management and conservation plans regarding the environment in each of the following items

rows.source_ko: 가. 생태계 및 생물다양성 등 자연ㆍ생태환경
rows.text_en: a. Natural and ecological environment, including ecosystems and biodiversity

rows.source_ko: 나. 대기ㆍ수질ㆍ토양 및 기후 등 생활ㆍ기후환경
rows.text_en: B. Living and climatic environment, including air, water quality, soil, and climate

rows.source_ko: 2. 시ㆍ군ㆍ구 환경계획의 추진을 위한 조직 및 예산
rows.text_en: 2. Organization and budget for the implementation of city, county, and district environmental plans

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항에서 규정한 사항 외에 시ㆍ군ㆍ구 환경계획의 수립 기준 및 작성 방법에 필요한 사항은 기후에너지환경부장관이 정한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 and 2, matters necessary for the standards for establishing and methods for drafting environmental plans for cities, counties, and districts shall be determined by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment . <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>
[This Article Newly Inserted July 6, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제6조(시ㆍ군 공간환경정보의 관리) ① 법 제19조제5항 및 영 제9조의2제2항에 따른 공간환경정보(이하 “시ㆍ군 공간환경정보”라 한다)에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Management of City/County Spatial Environment Information) ① Spatial environment information pursuant to Article 19 , Paragraph 5 of the Act and Article 9-2, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as “City/County Spatial Environment Information”) shall include the matters of each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 시장 또는 군수가 자체적으로 수집ㆍ생산하는 물, 대기, 자연생태 등 분야별 환경 현황에 관한 정보
rows.text_en: 1. Information on environmental status by sector, such as water, air, and natural ecosystems, collected and produced independently by the Mayor or County Head

rows.source_ko: 2. 그 밖에 기후에너지환경부장관이 정하여 고시하는 환경 현황에 관한 정보
rows.text_en: 2. Other information regarding the current environmental status determined and notified by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에서 규정한 사항 외에 시ㆍ군 공간환경정보의 관리에 필요한 사항은 기후에너지환경부장관이 정한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraph 1, matters necessary for the management of spatial environmental information of cities and counties shall be determined by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment . <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>
[This Article Newly Inserted July 6, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(국제환경협력센터 지정신청서 및 지정서) ① 「환경정책기본법 시행령」 (이하 “영”이라 한다) 제12조의2제4항 각 호 외의 부분에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 국제환경협력센터 지정신청서”란 별지 제1호서식의 국제환경협력센터 지정신청서를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Application for Designation and Designation Certificate for International Environmental Cooperation Center) ① In the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 12-2, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on Environment Policy (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”), the term “application for designation of an International Environmental Cooperation Center prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” refers to the application for designation of an International Environmental Cooperation Center in Form No. 1 of the Appendix. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제12조의2제5항에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 국제환경협력센터 지정서”란 별지 제2호서식의 국제환경협력센터 지정서를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② In Article 12-2, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree , the term “Certificate of Designation of International Environmental Cooperation Center prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” refers to the Certificate of Designation of International Environmental Cooperation Center in Form No. 2 of the Attached Form. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

[This Article was newly added on May 26, 2020.]

[Moved from Article 3 on July 6, 2021.]

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <기후에너지환경부령 제1호, 2025. 10. 1.> (기후에너지환경부와 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment Decree No. 1, Oct. 1, 2025> (Enforcement Rule on the Organization of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and its Affiliated Agencies)

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 부칙 제6조에 따라 개정되는 부령 중 이 규칙 시행 전에 공포되었으나 시행일이 도래하지 아니한 부령을 개정한 부분은 각각 해당 부령의 시행일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, among the Ministerial Ordinances amended pursuant to Article 6 of the Addenda, the parts amending Ministerial Ordinances that were promulgated prior to the enforcement of this Rule but whose effective date has not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective effective dates of those Ordinances.

rows.source_ko: 제2조 부터 제5조까지 생략
rows.text_en: Articles 2  through 5 omitted

rows.source_ko: 제6조(다른 법령의 개정) ①부터 <97>까지 생략
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Amendment of Other Laws)  ① through <97> Omitted

rows.source_ko: <98> 환경정책기본법 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: <98> The Enforcement Rules of the Framework Act on Environment are partially amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제2조, 제3조제3항, 제4조제1항제2호, 같은 조 제2항, 제5조제3항, 제6조제1항제2호 및 같은 조 제2항 중 “환경부장관”을 각각 “기후에너지환경부장관”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 2, Article 3 Paragraph 3, Article 4 Paragraph 1 Subparagraph 2, Article 4 Paragraph 2, Article 5 Paragraph 3, Article 6 Paragraph 1 Subparagraph 2, and Article 6 Paragraph 2, “Minister of Environment” shall be changed to “Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment”.

rows.source_ko: 제2조 중 “환경부 인터넷 홈페이지”를 “기후에너지환경부 인터넷 홈페이지”로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 2, “Ministry of Environment Internet Homepage” shall be changed to “Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment Internet Homepage”.

rows.source_ko: 제7조제1항 및 제2항 중 “환경부령”을 각각 “기후에너지환경부령”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 7, Paragraphs 1 and 2, “Ordinance of the Ministry of Environment” shall be changed to “Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment”.

rows.source_ko: 별지 제1호서식 및 별지 제2호서식 중 “환경부장관”을 각각 “기후에너지환경부장관”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Form No. 1 and Form No. 2, “Minister of Environment” shall be changed to “Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment”.

rows.source_ko: 별지 제1호서식의 처리절차란 중 “환경부”를 각각 “기후에너지환경부”로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the processing procedure section of Form No. 1, “Ministry of Environment” shall be changed to “Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment”.
